transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because I keep making these dumb technical mistakes at work. Stuff I know better than to make. Like... labeling camera cards wrong, or missing a timecode note. 

I even exported a client cut with the wrong lower-third recently, right after I had just checked it. It just... finally scared me into coming in, I guess.
Has this difficulty with focus and making careless mistakes been a recent change, or is it something you have dealt with for most of your life?

Um... no, it's not recent. I guess it's been a thing for most of my life. 

Even back in elementary school, the teachers were always moving my desk. I guess I was just... out of my seat a lot, or blurting out answers. Just bothering the other kids before I even realized I was doing it. So... yeah. It's not new.
Do you still find yourself feeling restless, fidgety, or having trouble sitting still nowadays?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I don't really sit still well. 

During edit reviews, I'm... always doing something. Clicking a pen, or... bouncing my knee under the desk. Sometimes I just roll my chair back and forth. 

People at work actually joke about it. They say they can hear me coming before they see me. So... yeah, still restless, I guess.
Do you often find yourself interrupting others or blurting out answers before someone has finished speaking?

Um... yeah, I guess I do that. Sometimes with a director, or... a client. I'll just kind of jump in with an answer before they finish their question. 

And then... I don't know, halfway through, I realize I'm answering the wrong thing. Just because I... reacted to the first few words they said. So... yeah.
